primary_rules.meaning: Entity encoding happens before these comment rules; unprotected hash begins a comment in INITIAL/ID/ALIAS/LINE. NUM is unrelated. ID has its own boundaries.
LINE restOfLine ends at unprotected #, newline or semicolon; both title forms are lexical tokens with whitespace, not starts_with(title) commands.
Semicolon is NEWLINE; actor syntax is separate from message markers.
TXT consumes ordinary text until unprotected #/newline/semicolon. Encoding protects atom semicolons first.
Participant AS and notes feed their complete text fields through parseMessage/text2; entity/BR processing must retain identity and note order.
Shield ASCII #\w+; before lexer; only all-decimal inner spelling is numeric. This is not arbitrary HTML support, signed numeric support or hex character-reference support.
Primary uses js-yaml JSON_SCHEMA and truthy title.toString. Existing native title-only plain profile remains separate from whole YAML compatibility.
CRLF normalization and frontmatter extraction precede directives/comments and entity encoding.

Primary case-insensitive regex </?br\s*/?> recognizes BR whitespace; getRows also converts literal backslash-n in its own helper. Only actual BR spellings required by these twelve sources are included here.
Break replacement is on original markup, before final entity unshield.
parseMessage/extractWrap trim field boundaries and preserve inner content; wrapping prefixes are not silently discarded by this cohort contract.
Sequence text is split on actual BR regex before each SVG text node is populated.
Text node assignment keeps escaped BR characters as text, not recursively parsed BR markup.
Foreign sanitization/HTML policy is distinct from native strict plain text and visible unsafe-scalar disclosure; no arbitrary tag stripping is authorized.
